climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

notes: Alto Adige wines stand out for their pronounced primary aromas.
Whites from vineyards above 300 to 400 m are notably fresh, yet fruity with good structure thanks to strong sun.
Late-harvest and passito wines are sweet and full.

blurb.text: South Tyrol, an autonomous province in northeast Italy. It was part of the Austro-Hungarian County of Tyrol until 1918, and its wine shows strong Austrian influence.
